purpose: Resolve the previously unspecified D_private selection rule without using checkpoint, pathology, protected, or FULL104 dimension outcomes.
candidate_rank_semantics: cumulative operator-native biological rank added beyond frozen D_shared
target: incremental prediction of common-core biological state/relations from lawful operator-native evidence beyond D_shared; raw residual variance and technical identity are not targets
selection_rule: Among contiguous jointly-supported positive prefixes, choose the smallest D_private whose held-donor incremental predictability is within one donor-level SE of the best jointly-supported prefix.
zero_rule: If no positive prefix is jointly supported, D_private = 0.
boundary_rule: If the highest tested positive prefix is jointly supported, do not select a numeric D_private; return EXPAND_PRIVATE_SEARCH_ENVELOPE prospectively.
forbidden_selection_sources: raw residual variance without common-core biological prediction
